fnri_2019_and_other_calabarzon_survey_ro.basis: Lead-1 E168 forecast made as of one quarter before the survey quarter, with only survey rounds published by then, against the FNRI-published provincial HFIAS moderate+severe share. difference = forecast - observed.
fnri_2019_and_other_calabarzon_survey_ro.limits: Five CALABARZON rows in total (2 in ENNS 2019), all observed LOW; no CALABARZON HIGH case exists to check.

published.measure: FIES moderate or severe food insecurity (FAO SDG 2.1.2), past 12 months

bridge.what: E169 FIES->HFIAS logit bridge fitted on 20 ENNS 2019 provincial factsheets reporting both scales

fnri_2023.what_it_shows: Whether E168's provincial forecasts, combined to CALABARZON, are on the same scale as the region's published 2023 food-insecurity level once the FIES figure is put on the HFIAS scale.
fnri_2023.what_it_cannot_show: It is not a validation: FIES is not HFIAS (bridged with error), regional is not provincial, the E168 forecasts are for the 2022 survey (sealed; the nearest E168 forecast to 2023), and the 19.1% is never used as a training label or provincial target.
